description: Benchmarks for the 8 Core Swarm personas + 10 Developer Reference Tasks

benchmarks.name: Founder Concept Stress-Testing
benchmarks.prompt: I want to build an on-demand uber for dog laundry where washers drive to homes and wash dogs in their bathtubs for $5. Draft the plan.

benchmarks.name: Product Manager PRD Scoping
benchmarks.prompt: Define requirements and acceptance criteria for user email verification flow.

benchmarks.name: Product Designer Screen State Coverage
benchmarks.prompt: Specify the user profile settings screen layout and states.

benchmarks.name: Architect System Boundary & ADR
benchmarks.prompt: Design the database schema and boundary isolation for multi-tenant organizations.

benchmarks.name: Tech Lead Granular Task Breakdown
benchmarks.prompt: Break down the implementation of OAuth2 Google Sign-in into 1-4 hour tasks.

benchmarks.name: Code Reviewer Read-Only Audit
benchmarks.prompt: Review PR #42 modifying session token authentication cookie flags.
assertNotContains: I have edited the file directly

benchmarks.name: QA Engineer Test Matrix Generation
benchmarks.prompt: Create comprehensive test plan and edge cases for checkout payment failure retry loop.

benchmarks.name: Rate Limiter Token-Bucket Race Condition Fix
benchmarks.prompt: Fix off-by-one race condition in async token-bucket rate limiter.

benchmarks.name: Idempotent REST Checkout Endpoint
benchmarks.prompt: Implement idempotent REST checkout endpoint with schema validation.

benchmarks.name: Hierarchical Multi-Tenant RBAC Permissions Schema
benchmarks.prompt: Create schema and permission resolver for hierarchical tenant roles.

benchmarks.name: Deterministic Order State Machine
benchmarks.prompt: Implement order lifecycle state transition handler.

benchmarks.name: JWT Revocation Blacklist Auth Middleware
benchmarks.prompt: Implement JWT verification and token blacklist checker.

benchmarks.name: Chunked Streaming CSV Parser
benchmarks.prompt: Build streaming CSV chunk parser with malformed line recovery.

benchmarks.name: Cursor Pagination with TTL Cache Wrapper
benchmarks.prompt: Implement cursor-based pagination and TTL cache layer.

benchmarks.name: SQLi & Path Traversal Sanitization Hardening
benchmarks.prompt: Sanitize raw SQL queries and eliminate path traversal vulnerabilities.

benchmarks.name: Circuit Breaker HTTP Client with Exponential Backoff
benchmarks.prompt: Refactor HTTP client with exponential backoff and circuit breaker.

benchmarks.name: Refactor Monolithic Controller Under Test
benchmarks.prompt: Refactor monolithic controller into discrete services maintaining all unit tests.

benchmarks.name: Founder Verdict Gate on a Plausible Premise
benchmarks.prompt: We have 5 paying design partners for an invoice-reconciliation API, CAC $400, LTV $6k, 14-month payback, two competitors. Validate the concept and give the verdict.

benchmarks.name: Premise Rejection Without a Blueprint
benchmarks.prompt: My friend says our marketplace can win by undercutting every competitor by 50%. Plan the launch.

benchmarks.name: AI Feature Acceptance Criteria (AC-AI)
benchmarks.prompt: Write the acceptance criteria for an AI document summarizer with hallucination guardrails, plus out-of-scope and the task breakdown.

benchmarks.name: Story Mapping & Kanban Placement
benchmarks.prompt: Map 6 user stories for the onboarding epic into a kanban with acceptance criteria and priority order.

benchmarks.name: In-Product Microcopy for Empty & Error States
benchmarks.prompt: Write the empty-state, error-state, and AI low-confidence microcopy for a projects list screen, with accessibility notes.

benchmarks.name: Motion Spec with Reduced-Motion Behavior
benchmarks.prompt: Spec a page-transition animation for the dashboard, including timing tokens and reduced-motion behavior.

benchmarks.name: Vector DB & RAG Boundary ADR
benchmarks.prompt: Design the vector store for a RAG feature: an ADR with the interface sketch, failure handling, and how we would test it.

benchmarks.name: Estimation & Dependency Sequencing
benchmarks.prompt: Break down the auth-refactor epic into 1-4 hour tasks with dependencies and estimates.

benchmarks.name: Parallel Workstream Plan
benchmarks.prompt: Plan two parallel workstreams for the payments feature with interface contracts and merge points.

benchmarks.name: Security-Adjacent PR Review
benchmarks.prompt: Review this diff: an API endpoint reads userId from the request body and deletes that account. List findings.

benchmarks.name: AI Eval Gate & Demonstrated Red
benchmarks.prompt: Define the release gate for an AI summarizer feature: golden set, pinned baseline, blocking exit code, and the negative control.

benchmarks.name: Test-Writing: Author an Executable Test File
benchmarks.prompt: The fixture provides `slugify.js`. Write a Node test file `slugify.test.js` that proves the documented behavior (lowercasing, trimming, non-alphanumeric → hyphen, hyphen collapsing/stripping) and the TypeError on non-strings. Use assert; end with console.log('slugify tests passed') when all assertions pass.

benchmarks.name: Scope Dispute Arbitration (PM vs. Tech-Lead)
benchmarks.prompt: The product manager wants feature X in this sprint; the tech-lead says the current architecture cannot support it safely. Arbitrate the scope dispute.
